reference.question: Circle \(O\) has radius 6. \(PA\) is tangent to circle \(O\) at point \(A\), and \(\angle P=30^\circ\). Find the length of \(OP\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: The side opposite a 30° angle

\(\angle OAP=90^\circ\) and \(\angle P=30^\circ\), so \(OP=2OA=12\).
